title: Performable Music / Forty-eight differentiated compositional mechanisms
scope: 48 substantially different musical hypotheses. NOT 48 songs, finished recordings, usable stems or artist clones.
performance_context: CRITICAL FIELD / December 3; music first, visuals on hold

audition_pipeline.note: The 12 are eligible for short feasibility tests, not automatically selected for production.
audition_pipeline.continuity_rule: For club-lane prototypes keep a perceptible rhythmic anchor across most phrases. Silence/cuts must earn their role and never be random holes.
audition_pipeline.music_first: Two full phrase cycles with audible motif and purposeful development before styling, output 24-bit WAV and aligned stems.
audition_pipeline.reject_repetition: Reject duplicate mechanism or two designs that differ only by BPM, key, patch, more layers, louder master or a visual cue.
audition_pipeline.human_gate: A human compares blind audio with volume matching, timestamps and reasons to reject/keep.
